import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier, EarlyStopping
import time

# Set paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
OUTPUT_FILE = f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv"

# Load Data
try:
    train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/train.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/test.csv")
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/sample_submission.csv")
except Exception as e:
    raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to load data: {e}")

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Prepare Target - IMPORTANT: Keep 'Cover_Type' as target, NOT feature
y_train_full = train_df["Cover_Type"]
X_train_full = train_df.drop(columns=["Id", "Cover_Type"])
test_X = test_df.drop(columns=["Id"])

print(f"Training features count: {X_train_full.shape[1]}")
print(f"Hold-out features count: {test_X.shape[1]}")

# Create clean hold-out validation set FIRST (truly unseen during training phase)
# This ensures validation score is a real estimate of generalization performance
start_time = time.time()
X_hold_out, X_rest, y_hold_out, y_rest = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, shuffle=True
)

# Now combine rest for final training (ensuring validation remains completely unseen)
X_final_train = X_rest
y_final_train = y_rest

print(
    f"Validation set size: {len(y_hold_out)}, Training set size: {len(y_final_train)}"
)

# Initialize Model with optimized hyperparameters for forest cover type
model = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=5000,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=60,
    max_depth=-1,
    bagging_freq=1,
    verbose=-1,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    subsample=0.9,
    colsample_bytree=0.9,
    min_child_samples=20,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
)

# Add EarlyStoppingCallback - CRITICAL improvement to prevent overfitting
early_stopping_callback = EarlyStopping(
    stopping_rounds=100, verbose=False, verbose_eval=1
)

# Train ONLY on final training data (never touch hold-out during training!)
print("Starting training with early stopping...")
training_end_time = start_time + 10  # Allow extra time for potential callbacks
while True:
    try:
        model.fit(
            X_final_train,
            y_final_train,
            eval_set=[(X_hold_out, y_hold_out)],
            eval_metric="accuracy",
            early_stopping_rounds=100,
            verbose=False,
            callback_func=lambda record, stage, name: print(
                name.split("_")[0] if "best_score" in str(record) else ""
            ),
        )
        break
    except Exception:
        print("Interrupted, trying again...")
        break

# Evaluate on truly independent hold-out validation set
val_predictions = model.predict(X_hold_out)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_hold_out, val_predictions)
print(f"Hold-out Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Generate submissions on unlabeled test data
test_predictions = model.predict(test_X)
submission_df = sample_sub.copy()
submission_df["Cover_Type"] = test_predictions.astype(int)
submission_df.to_csv(OUTPUT_FILE, index=False)

print("Submission saved successfully!")
print(f"Training completed in {time.time() - start_time:.2f} seconds")
print(f"- Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")
print(f"- Total Test Predictions: {len(test_predictions)}")
print(f"- Submission File: {OUTPUT_FILE}")
